name: recovery_monitoring
title: Recovery monitoring
outcome: Two numbers: the recovery score (0 to 100; 100 = vital signs normal and no worse than at discharge; Good from 75, Moderate from 50, Poor below 50) and the probability of a deterioration episode within 72 hours (alert from 0.348), which the band follows
label: Recovery monitoring score

metrics.split: held-out test patients; 5-fold cross-validation by patient
metrics.platform_parity: the platform's inputs match the author's training table to 6 decimal places; AUROC 0.989 through the platform's feature path on the training data (0.991 on the author's table)

trained_on: 263 patients of the shared training data (MIMIC-IV-demo discharge state and the synthetic 72-hour wearable streams), scored at 1, 3, 6, 12 and 24 hours after discharge
limitations: The outcome is defined by the data generator's danger rules, not observed clinical events. Trained on the first 24 hours after discharge; the platform scores patients later than that, where the model treats them like a 24-hour patient. The alert threshold is the author's (0.348); below it the 72-hour chance is shown as low. With model confirmation switched on (off by default), a home patient's medium NEWS2 becomes an alert only when this model or the other confirming model is at or above its alert threshold.
source: Recovery Monitoring Score - Model Files/recovery_score_model (hand-over of 2026-10-14)
